ruleDefinitions.name: File Decryption Using Gpg4win
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects usage of Gpg4win to decrypt files

sequences.query: (((process_path = RGX("\\\\gpg\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\gpg2\\\.exe$")) OR process_description = "GnuPG’s\ OpenPGP\ tool") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\ \\-d\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*passphrase.*")))
